title: Reinstallation of materials.
officialText:
Existing slate, clay or cement tile shall be permitted for reinstallation, except that damaged,
cracked or broken slate or tile shall not be reinstalled. Existing vent flashing, metal edgings, drain outlets, collars and metal
counterflashings shall not be reinstalled where rusted, damaged or deteriorated. Aggregate surfacing materials shall not be
reinstalled.
